descriptions.overview: Get an instant snapshot of the selected site's key metrics.
descriptions.byAuthor: List content created or modified by specific authors.
descriptions.byAllDate: Break down content activity per month and type.
descriptions.references: The report only contains content which is used on any page. Unused content from content folders will not appear.
descriptions.unusedAssets: List the assets stored under the selected files path that are not referenced anywhere in the site.
descriptions.byAuthorAndDate: Filter content by combining date and author criteria.
descriptions.wipContent: View content marked as Work in Progress (WIP). These items are still being edited and are not ready for publication.
descriptions.contentWaitingPublication: List all content that has a pending workflow task. This includes content awaiting review, approval, or publication.
descriptions.markedForDeletion: View content that has been marked for deletion. This report shows items flagged for removal along with the number of child nodes affected.
descriptions.lockedContent: View all content that is currently locked by users. This report displays who created the content, who has it locked, and where it's located. Useful for identifying content that may need to be unlocked.
descriptions.customCacheContent: View content with custom cache expiration settings. This report identifies content that has specific cache configuration applied, showing the expiration values and helping optimize cache performance.
descriptions.aclInheritanceBreak: Identify content where ACL (Access Control List) inheritance has been broken. This report shows nodes that have custom permissions set, overriding permissions from parent nodes. Useful for auditing security configurations.
descriptions.siteModules: List every module deployed on the selected site with its version, type, bundle state and how it got there: the site's template set, a module installed on the site, or a dependency pulled in by one of those. The last column counts the component types each module declares.
descriptions.componentUsage: For each module deployed on the site, list the component types it declares and how many nodes of exactly that type exist under the site. Components with zero instances are listed too; sort the usage column ascending to bring them to the top.
descriptions.pagesWithoutTitle: Identify pages that are missing titles in one or more languages. The report displays the path and shows which languages have titles defined.
descriptions.pagesUntranslated: Identify content that has not been translated into a specific language. Select the target language to find content that exists in other languages but is missing the translation.
descriptions.liveContents: View content with live visibility conditions. This report displays content that has conditional visibility rules applied, showing the conditions, matching status, and current visibility state.
descriptions.expiredContents: View content with expired visibility conditions. This report identifies content that has visibility end dates that have already passed, making the content no longer visible on the live site.
descriptions.futureContents: View content scheduled to go live in the future. This report shows content with visibility start dates that have not yet been reached, allowing you to preview upcoming content publications.
descriptions.partialLanguageVisibility: View pages and content that editors switched off in some of the site's languages (Visibility > Languages in Content Editor). Page Builder still shows them in every language; preview and the live site leave them out in the languages listed as hidden.
descriptions.pagesWithoutKeywords: Identify pages that are missing SEO keywords. This report helps you find pages that need keyword metadata for better search engine optimization.
descriptions.pagesWithoutDescription: Identify pages that are missing descriptions in one or more languages. The report displays the path and shows which languages have descriptions defined for better SEO and accessibility.
descriptions.usersGroups: Generate a CSV report of all Jahia users across all sites, including their group memberships. Reports are stored in JCR and can be downloaded directly from this page.
